2. At the December 10, 1977 meeting individual project proposals were presented by citizens. Staff project proposals were presented to the Steering Committee the previous week. The purpose of this meeting was to hear community-supported ideas from CDBG funding and to discuss the recommendation to the City Council of areas designated as neighborhood revitalization areas.
Forty-one separate projects were presented and described. Descriptions of a representative sample are given below.
(a) Alviso (8 projects)
Operation Clean-up
Question: Have you checked into monies available to local police
departments for removal of abandoned cars?
Answer: Junked cars are not necessarily abandoned.
Assessment District
Proposal limited to formation of an assessment district.
Residential Streets
Improvements wanted on State, Spreckles and Grand Blvd.
Residential Rehabilitation
Staff was asked to look into City policy on Code Enforcement and move-ins in Alviso.
Park Lighting and Fencing
Question: Have all projects been screened to see if they are included
in the Capital Improvment Program?
Answer: They have been screened and are not in.
Wilson Way Improvement
There is no legal record of land being dedicated to the City.
Library Expansion
Skateboard Park
Proposal request is to buy land and put in Skateboard Park. It's assumed operational costs would be covered by profits after the first year.
